description: Match begins at SoFi Stadium.
Minor foul in midfield.
Minor foul in midfield.
Rodri's set-piece effort from 13 yards is blocked.
Álex Baena's low effort from 16 yards is blocked.
Belgium attacker flagged offside.
Spain corner from the right.
Foul on Rodri, free kick to Spain.
Fabián Ruiz slams home the rebound after Courtois fails to control the initial save. 1-0.
Spain attacker flagged offside.
Spain corner from the left.
Charles De Ketelaere heads in Timothy Castagne's cross to level the match. 1-1.
Charles De Ketelaere booked shortly after his equalizer.
Pau Cubarsí booked for a tactical foul.
Half time: Spain 1-1 Belgium.
Lamine Yamal released by Cubarsí, denied one-on-one by Courtois.
Foul on Yamal in the final third.
Pedri replaces Fabián Ruiz.
Ferran Torres replaces Álex Baena.
Doku-De Bruyne one-two sends De Cuyper clear; he fires into the side netting.
Romelu Lukaku replaces Leandro Trossard (unconfirmed pairing, see README).
Joaquin Seys replaces Maxim De Cuyper.
Lamine Yamal's effort beaten away by Courtois, who also saves from Oyarzabal.
Foul on De Bruyne, free kick to Belgium.
Doku curls an effort wide from distance.
Thibaut Courtois forced off in tears with an apparent thigh injury.
Senne Lammens replaces Thibaut Courtois (injury).
Spain win a corner after sustained pressure.
Belgium concede a foul in their defensive third.
Yamal curls an effort just wide.
Spain's fifth corner of the match.
Mikel Merino replaces Dani Olmo.
Alexis Saelemaekers replaces Kevin De Bruyne.
Merino scores with his second touch after Lammens spills Cubarsí's low shot. 2-1.
Aymeric Laporte booked for time-wasting/tactical foul in stoppage time.
Full time: Spain 2-1 Belgium. Spain advance to face France in the semi-final.
